HDR 120 dB (106 dB per IEC 62676-5 with 12-40 mm lens)
Intelligent Video Analytics with Camera Trainer; 3D tracking

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.

release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (NDE_8504_RT_Fixed_do_Data_sheet_enUS_94290272779.pdf), 12-40 mm lens columns. NDE-8504-RT = tele-lens variant of NDE-8504-R (3.9-10 mm, separate record); motorized tilt -3 to +90 deg on the RT. Made to order. FOV wide 36.2 x 19.9, tele 12.6 x 7.1 (H x V). Power consumption max 16 W (12-26 VDC), 12.95 W max on PoE.
